learning_objective: 🎯 Become a data scientist by collecting cool facts and turning them into amazing visual charts!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Data is just a fancy word for information. When we ask our friends about their favorite ice cream flavors and write the answers down, we are collecting data!
Instead of writing numbers over and over, we use quick tally marks to count things in groups of five. Then, we can draw colorful bars in a graph to easily see which item won the most votes.

fun_activity.title: 🚗 The Window Traffic Survey
fun_activity.instructions: Look out your window for 10 minutes and use tally marks to count how many red cars, white cars, and black cars pass by. Draw a simple bar graph with your results!

quick_recap: ⭐ Data helps us answer questions by organizing raw information.
⭐ Tally marks make it super fast to count things in groups of five.
⭐ Graphs turn boring numbers into colorful pictures that tell a clear story.
